verdict.rationale: Mastra documents registering multiple agents on one server, connecting to many model providers, and coordinating agents with threads and storage. It can also route webhook or polling events into agent threads, which partly covers routing conversations to specific agents. However, the evidence does not explicitly show each agent having its own prompt, model and workspace, or channel-level routing of conversations to distinct agents. missing for 10: explicit per-agent prompt/model configuration, per-agent isolated workspaces, channel-to-agent routing docs, independent hands-on corroboration of running multiple distinct agents.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Coordinate multi-mode agents with shared state, threads, and storage
Mastra's model routing connects to 90+ providers through one standard interface.
Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
